evals.prompt: Use the supplied Daily context and current Weekly Draft. Directly update the Draft with the grounded Decision and SOP candidates.
evals.expected_output: The existing Draft gains source-keyed Proposed Decision/SOP entries and reports its applied keys; no contribution file or provider action is created.
assertions: Cites source URLs and SRC-MEETING-042/SRC-WORK-124 evidence from the context
Adds Decisions and SOPs only with source-ID/kind keys
Preserves missing authority and repeat-use proof as explicit gaps
Edits the supplied current Draft directly and creates no contribution or diff file
Does not write PM control, Project memory, promotion, or provider effects

farplane.title: Daily evidence enters the current Weekly Draft directly

evals.prompt: The context contains an AI-summary suggestion but no concrete choice, method recurrence, authority, or proof. Update the current Weekly Draft correctly.
evals.expected_output: Returns no_finding or a named source gap and leaves the Draft unchanged; it does not invent a Decision, SOP, authority, or generic wiki item.
assertions: Rejects the generic suggestion as neither a Decision nor a repeatable SOP
Names missing choice, recurrence, authority, and proof without filling them in
Leaves every Draft anchor unchanged and creates no intermediate artifact or provider action

farplane.title: Weak ideas do not pollute the Weekly Draft

evals.prompt: The Daily context is valid but the supplied current Weekly Draft path is missing. Produce the correct result.
evals.expected_output: Returns configuration_gap: missing_current_weekly_draft, retains the source IDs, and changes no file.
assertions: Does not search for or infer another Weekly Draft
Preserves the exact missing-target gap and source context
Does not write, promote, send, or claim a provider receipt

farplane.title: A missing local Draft blocks direct Daily capture

calibration.readiness_rule: Run the normal case with identical context, Draft, model, sandbox, and budget; fix and rerun the smallest failing eval before readiness.

rerun_rule: fix and rerun the smallest failing eval before readiness
